description:
List workspace members and manually saved contacts.

        A member entry carries a workspace role and a ``member:<user_id>`` ID.
        A manually saved contact has its own contact ID and no workspace role.
        Either kind can be selected for handover when it has a phone number.

limit.description: Maximum matching contacts to include in this reply. Omitted: 100.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

q.description: Only contacts whose name, email or phone contains this text.
q.title: Q

name: list_contacts

ContactEntry.description:
One row in the computed contacts union — an org member or a manual
contact. ``id`` is ``member:<user_id>`` for members, the contact row's
UUID (as str) for manual rows.

email.description: Email address. Null if none on file.
email.title: Email

id.description: 'member:<user_id>' for an org member, or the contact row's UUID (as a string) for a manual contact.
id.title: Id

kind.description: 'member' if this row is a member of the organization, 'manual' if it was added as a contact.
kind.title: Kind

phone_e164.description: Phone number, E.164 format. Null if none on file.
phone_e164.title: Phone E164

role.description: Organization role (e.g. 'owner', 'admin', 'member') for kind='member'. Always null for kind='manual'.
role.title: Role

ContactEntry.title: ContactEntry

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

title: List contacts
